messages:
maria: FYI canary embed-service on release/2026-03-23 showing p95 jump +140ms (baseline ~40ms -> 180ms). Error rate flat. deploy-bot flagged an autorevert. change window closes in ~35m. Thoughts: let bot revert fully or run a scoped rollback for embeddings route only?

raj: Any config diffs? model variant mismatch?

maria: small routing misbind. Latest job switched to v2.4.0 (non-quant) by accident; should be v2.4.0-quant. We also toggled kernel-opt flags in the last patch. Suspect kernel selection on GPU.

deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT_ALERT: target=embed-canary-2, metric=p95_latency, threshold=+100ms, observed=+140ms. Recommended action: suggest_revert_to=quant-stable, plan_id=rb-5010.

sam: If kernel opt is the culprit, a revert to quant-stable is lowest risk. Hotpatching kernel flags in-window is risky.

erin: Note: dedicated customers were prenotice about quant rollout. If we revert, need immediate customer update and RN edit.

maria: Prefer granular approach: revert embeddings route on canary-slice only, keep other routes progressing. Limits blast radius and buys time for runtime debug.

raj: Our deploy platform supports route-level traffic-slices. Caveat: pinned dedicated tenants won't be affected. We'll need to coordinate any dedicated unpin separately.

ops-bot: WARNING: partial reverts within an active change window <60m require ops approval. Please request approval now.

sam: I approve ops side. @raj you have go for partial revert. Also create a pinned fallback variant so we don't flip again.

raj: Running staged rollback:
```
deploy rollback --target embed-canary-2 --route embeddings --from v2.4.0 --to v2.4.0-quant-stable --slice canary-2 --notes "partial revert due to p95 spike"
```

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback initiated by raj. step1: shift 50% -> 0% on v2.4.0 for slice canary-2. step2: wait for healthchecks. estimated 90s to converge.

ops-bot: AUTH: approved by sam. change window allowed.

erin: I'll draft the RN hotfix blurb: "Rollback: embeddings route reverted to quant-stable after p95 latency regression in canary. Investigating runtime kernel selection." Also prepping a short customer notice for pinned tenants.

deploy-bot: step1 complete. traffic shifted. healthchecks passing. observed p95 for slice down to +5ms above baseline after 2m.

raj: Metrics look clean. No new errors. Good signal.

maria: Great. Keep the revert in place until runtime confirms kernel flags are safe. Open ENG-5010 to track root cause and coord with runtime and CI.

sam: Created ENG-5010, assigned to eng-runtime. Link: http://tickets/ENG-5010.

erin: Customer note sent to dedicated customers and status page updated: "Resolved (partial revert). Investigating root cause." :white_check_mark:

maria: Marking this incident as manual rollback (ops-approved) even though deploy-bot suggested auto. Nice coordinated run. We'll reconvene after ENG-5010 updates. Closing thread after 30m stable window.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback completed. record=rb-5010. timeline attached.

maria: Thanks everyone. Monitor for 30m, reopen here if any regressions.
